title: 21st Sitting of first Session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/21/1/2025).

Question time: Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim asks the Minister of Dhivehi Language, Culture and Heritage, Adam Naseer Ibrahim, when restoration of the Malé Hukuru Miskiy (Friday Mosque) will restart and finish, given that the conservation work stopped when this government took office, pillars altering the original have been installed inside, and the mosque is now in a dangerous state.

Question time: the same MP asks the same minister when the Kalhuvakaru Mosque and the surrounding park will open, noting that six months were spent reassembling the mosque yet the area has been closed for over a year on the grounds that a Kalhuohfummi replica is being brought and repairs are under way, and it has not been officially confirmed that the replica is built to the original dimensions.
Foreign Relations Committee report on the President's nominations of non-resident ambassadors to the Kingdom of Sweden, the Republic of Seychelles and the Republic of Austria.

Independent Institutions Committee report on the President's nominee for appointment to the Civil Service Commission under Article 180(b) of the Constitution and Article 13 of the Civil Service Act (Law No. 5/2007).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was set to question the heritage minister on the stalled Friday Mosque and Kalhuvakaru Mosque works, then take up committee reports on three non-resident ambassador nominees and a Civil Service Commission appointment.
